neighbours.label: copula or determiner right after a demonstrative or discourse reference in chatty prose ('so this is', 'despite these', 'that was')
fire: I'm a teacher and my partner loves books, so this is a big deal for us.

No, that was not the reason she stayed home that night.
We both cook every day, so this is really useful in our kitchen.

If the light kept blinking, that is likely what the engineer meant.
Even with those small problems, the trip was worth every penny.
